newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakhs to sell 66 pct of biggest power plant.
newsitem.headline: Kazakhs to sell 66 pct of biggest power plant.

text.p: Kazakhstan will hold a tender on July 21 for the sale of a 66 percent stake in the country's largest thermal power plant, AO Ekibastuzskaya GRES-2 in the northern Pavlodar region, the government announced on Monday.

The finance ministry's privatisation department said the stake being tendered is worth 16.875 billion tenge ($223.5 million), and tender conditions called for a minimum investment of 29.9 billion tenge ($387 million) by 2002.
"The price paid by a winner may be less than $223.5 million but its investment offer would have to be the best," a privatisation official told Reuters.
